newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville Power raises prices, adds transmission.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville Power raises prices, adds transmission.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration raised most of its next-day offer prices and will assess extra charges for transmission, the federal power marketing agency said Monday.
BPA also limited Tuesday firm sales to 200 megawatts (MW) and non-firm to 500 MW.
For Tuesday pre-schedulings, Bonneville offered firm power during peak hours of 0600-2300 PDT at $21.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), up from $20.00 between 0800 and 2100 on Monday.
Non-firm peak power on Tuesday was offered at $19.00, unchanged from Monday.
Off-peak firm power was offered at $16.00 for Tuesday, compared with $15.00 on Monday. Non-firm, off-peak prices were unchanged from Monday's at $14.00.
Bonneville said it will add an extra $1.00 per MWh to cover transmission costs to Northwest delivery points and another $2.27 to California-Oregon border and Nevada-Oregon border sales.
